test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/670d6941e0097cfec50b80b5865a680f4392b586a4a0a260baf96d1e0ed752ba.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

Top-right, middle-left, bottom-left, and middle-right symbols are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

Middle symbols is replaced by a new symbol.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

Top-right, middle and bottom-left symbols are shifting their position in a clockwise direction.

Middle-left and middle-right surface symbols are interchanging their position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e184ae2c9db8f37c2526af8cd493fa9834545610fa9d6f864ab5ce4a5905230b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
